title.label: Does not maintain PC daily login streak

content.label:
Beware: this mobile app may not preserve your PC daily login streak. Even if you have seriously invested in your account, they're not going to lift a finger to help you. You're just a number, and they have enough numbers already.

Installed the mobile app and logged in daily while traveling for a few days, specifically to maintain my 2+ year daily login streak on PC/Steam. The accounts are linked correctly. Arrived home to find my streak had reset to Day 1. Opened an issue with Gaijin support only to be told "We regret to inform you that we do not revert changes on our users' accounts."

This is the same company that broke top tier aircraft radar and missiles repeatedly for a year, ignoring numerous complaints while those affected kept being told "skill issue" by the inferior players who benefitted and sometimes the company support staff themselves. Not a great way to treat paying customers.

I was on the fence about renewing my premium account that just expired, but losing the login streak after doing everything right made that an easy decision. It's a shame nobody votes with their dollars or feet anymore and we all tolerate brokenness and lack of support this way, but that is the world we live in now. It was a great game, but the company doesn't care anymore, because they don't need to. If they won't even bother to investigate such a simple issue, then I'm out.

title.label: Love the game but lack of research for new things like planes and tanks

content.label:
I’ve been playing War Thunder Mobile for a while now and recently reached Rank IV, but the experience has become incredibly frustrating. While I love the concept of the game, the grind for new tanks and planes has become a massive wall. It currently feels like it takes 5+ business days of constant play just to unlock a single new platoon, and often that new platoon isn't even competitive in its tier.
The matchmaking is also very difficult for players like me. Being in Rank IV and constantly facing modern tanks like the Abrams or advanced jets is discouraging because my WWII-era vehicles simply can't compete. It feels like the game is pushing me to spend money just to survive a match.
I would love to see the developers look into 'BR Compression' and consider lowering the research requirements for Rank IV and V. It would make the game much more enjoyable for the average player who wants to progress without feeling stuck for weeks at a time. I really want to keep playing, but the current grind is making it hard to stay motivated. Please consider making progression a bit more balanced for everyone!"Beyond the grind, the matchmaking for solo players is very frustrating. I constantly find myself on teams where my teammates don't help or play the objective, making it impossible to win against organized enemy squads. When you spend 5 business days grinding for a tank only to lose match after match because of poor team balance, it makes the game feel very unfair."Also, the Silver Lion rewards need to be balanced. Currently, repair costs are so high and match rewards are so low that it’s almost impossible to save up enough currency to buy the tanks I’ve already spent days researching."I also feel that Platinum Wolfs are too hard to earn for free. It makes the game feel like 'Pay-to-Win' because the most competitive tanks are locked behind premium currency that takes way too long to collect."
